title.narrative: Strengthening skills and training capacity in the horticulture sector

description.narrative:
**Long-term impact**
- Reduce malnutrition - Promote agricultural growth - Ecologically sustainable food systems
**Medium-term impact that will contribute to this**
- Education system (TVET/HE) is of good quality, relevant and accessible (SDG 4); - Partnerships between persons and organisations are inclusive and sustainable (SDG 17) - Organisations key to (sectoral) inclusive development of partner countries are strengthened by inflow of enhanced workforce
**Outcomes**
The following outcome has been defined at project level:
- TVET/HE organisations (in Tanzania and in NL) perform better their core tasks, firmly embedded in their environment (in line with country / regional specific labour market needs & aiming at inclusiveness).
To that end, the following outputs must be achieved by the end of the project:
- Increased quality of the educational programs of A-TVETs in horticulture sector - Increased institutional capacities to implement gender transformative Competency Based horticultural programs; - Improved entrepreneurial skills of staff and students and start up support services at A-TVETS; - Established and sustained triple helix horticulture innovation platform

comment.narrative:
03-11-2022: Four facilities (3 TVET and 1 NACTE) have been assessed on their required strengthening, and suppliers have been asked to provide quotations, after which 1 supplier per investment type was selected for supply & installation of goods and services.
-Greenhouse facilities, incl. installation at 2 TVETs -Contribution to online learning modules development for 3 TVETs -Online connectivity & infrastructure to enable blended & fully online learning at 2 TVETs -Laptops for blended & online learning at 2 TVETs -Improved online meeting equipment at NACTE

title.narrative: number of organisations revised/developed and implemented a strategic plan

comment.narrative: 03-11-2022: A first step to come to strategic plans for the 3 TVETs and NACTE has been made during the Curriculum Workshop, and during the gender strategy training. The next step is that once the greenhouses and online infrastructures are in place next steps will be made that will result in actual strategic plans. Expected planning: Q1 2022.

17-03-2021: Strategic plans for TVETs will be developed in workshops once the curriculum development process is finalized and a decision has been made on the final purchasing list per TVET for online learning and practical training facilities equipment has been approved. Due to Covid these processes were not yet finalized.

title.narrative: improved gender equality and gender awareness in the knowledge institution

comment.narrative: 03-11-2022: Training for 3 A-TVETs and NACTE management and staff on gender mainstreaming in teaching and industry extension was designed and developed in June/July 2021 and training was held in August 2021. Q-point gender expert, assisted with a local gender expert, provided a three-day training to in total 22 staff of 3 TVETs and NACTE.
17-03-2021: see narrative section: 'Opportunities for marginalized and vulnerable groups and gender perspective'

title.narrative: number of organisations with policies and procedures to ensure an environment which is conducive for minorities

comment.narrative: 03-11-2022: MATI Uyole has an ongoing gender strategy and club with a gender-focal personnel in place to support the gender affairs including creating an environment conducive for minorities. The process has been started but finalization will be at the end of the current year.

title.narrative: number of MoUs or other types of collaboration agreements signed (education, private, public, surrounding community)(in NL, own country, other country)

comment.narrative:
03-11-2022: MoUs: - NACTE with TVETs (curricula adoption and internet installation) - NACTE with MoA (3-year curriculum approved) - SUGECO & MATI Uyole (incubation and entrepreneurship programs) - MSM & Horti-Pro Limited (Greenhouse supplier) - MATI & ICT services Mbeya (IT services & Moodle orientation and rollout) - Horti Tengeru & ICT services Arusha (IT services & Moodle orientation and rollout) - Q-point and NACTE & TVETs (support on gender action plan formation and implementation)
With triple helix platform success formation in two TVETs, there will be more room open for MoUs between TVETs and public/private companies. But Covid situation prevented actors from meeting face to face to discuss and agree on such future collaborations

17-03-2021: Besides the project agreements signed by the TVETs and NACTE, no new collaboration agreements were signed as the Covid situation prevented actors from meeting face to face to discuss and agree on such future collaborations.

title.narrative: number of curricula for degree, non-degree and short courses revised/newly developed

comment.narrative: 03-11-2022: The review of a three year horticultural curricula has been finalised in collaboration with NACTE and MoA. Project advise on improvement of modules in these curricula were revised during a high-level industry and public stakeholder validation workshop organized by MoA, and suggested changes were accepted and included by MoA, and afterwards acredited by NACTE. The validation of the curriculum was in May 2021.

17-03-2021: Curriculum development process has started in year 1. Two potential routes were investigated: to revise the existing curricula currently used by TVETs (and that are under the Ministry of Agriculture) or to design a new curriculum under legal ownership of NACTE. It was agreed to go for a new NACTE curriculum. This process involves a number of official steps/activities and protocols, and the process has started in August 2020. Due to Covid these activities, which require face to face workshops, could not start earlier.

title.narrative: number of beneficiaries in the society reached with knowledge, skills and techniques (directly*)

comment.narrative: 03-11-2022: Around 15 teachers were trained in water-smart horticulture skills by and at the greenhouse facilities of Profyta, in Tanzania. These teachers will reach on average 15 students each, or 225 students. Additional beneficiaries will be reached through collaboration with and training of Triple Helix partners, applied research stakeholders, extension officers, and specifically through NACTE in its efforts to roll out the project to a good number of VETA schools in TZ. Due to Corona all face to face activities that should lead to reaching out to beneficiaries have been on hold and are expected to pick up early 2022.

17-03-2021: During the labour market needs assessment 50 horticulture sector actors, primarily producers and value adders, were included in on-site interviews and group workshops. These focused on the needed competencies of TVET college graduates, and provided insights and experiences to be used in the new curriculum. TVET and NACTE staff were trained in doing the interviews. Due to the Covid situation additional interviews by them were postponed.

title.narrative: number of staff have gained qualitative and relevant knowledge and skills to develop and offer the revised/developed study programmes (teacher/administrative, male/female, PhD/MSc/short training)

comment.narrative: 03-11-2022: Training of staff from 3 TVETS and NACTE staff was conducted online, in applied research methods. This training supports teachers in collecting and using data to improve study programs, including in linking to the industry for internship programs. The study was conducted in March 2021 for a week.

17-03-2021: TVET teachers and NACTE staff have been involved in the labour market needs analysis, which created good insights and understanding of what industry-driven horticulture study programs should offer. TVET and NACTE staff were also part of two assessments that were carried out for investing in blended learning at the TVETs: the online infrastructure assessment and the practical training facility assessment. They gained knowledge on how online teaching and practical training add to knowledge and skills of students, and how to carry out these assessments at their premisses.

title.narrative: diversity in management and teaching staff (i.e. balance junior/senior staff, women/men, minorities)

comment.narrative: 03-11-2022: The process has been started but finalization will be at the end of the project (the gender mainstreaming developed in June/July 2021 and held in Aug 2021 contributed to reaching this step. From the training reflection, the management of institutions are represented by an average a 65%-35% representation of male and female staff members. The institutions are already working on balancing the representation of female staff members in management and recruitment.
17-03-2021: see narrative section: 'Opportunities for marginalized and vulnerable groups and gender perspective'

title.narrative: number of relevant innovations

comment.narrative: 03-11-2022: Fifteen participants from the three beneficiary colleges were trained by Profyta on water smart agriculture. Through the training participants witnessed and practiced production in greenhouses, integrated pest management practices, fertigation and smart irrigation.

title.narrative: number of relevant publications (level, gender, inclusion)

comment.narrative: 03-11-2022: Online training on Applied Research was offered by MSM to teachers and management of TVETs and NACTE. This training contributed to strengthening their skills in writing relevant publications in the year to come. The training took place in March 2021. Several participants have started write up of research proposals on climate smart agriculture related topics, which will result in publications in the upcoming period.

03-11-2022: Progress has been started but finalization will be at the end of the project. Number of enroled students will be recorded now to match the number of graduate students at the end of the three-year program.
No graduate students (because it’s a 3 year program).

title.narrative: number of organisations revised/developed institutional mechanism for quality assurance

comment.narrative: 03-11-2022: The process has been started but finalization will be at the end of the project MSM will link to alumni and satisfaction, set up mechanism. Include a tracer mechanism. This activity requires face to face planning and takes place Q2 2022.

title.narrative: number of students enrolled in revised/newly developed study programmes (male/female)

comment.narrative: 03-11-2022: The validated curricula will be used by new enrolled students in September 2021.

title.narrative: number of organisations with improved policies or procedures to encourage access to education of minorities

comment.narrative: 03-11-2022: Through the curricula there will be an outreach program by the TVETs to encourage improve and open up access to education to minorities to youth and women. The outreach program will be supported by NACTE. Currently, in progress.

number of (knowledge) institutions supported directly

comment.narrative: 03-11-2022: Assessment for investment in facilities at the 3 TVET has been carried out, resulting in an exact mapping of investments in both practical training facilities as well as online infrastructure for blended/online learning by students. 2 of the 3 TVETs will receive fully operational greenhouses by September 2021. 2 of the 3 TVETs will receive laptops and online learning infrastructure by September 2021.
